newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher, relieved by stable yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher, relieved by stable yen.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately higher on Tuesday as participants were relieved by a stable yen after its sudden surge hammered the key stock index lower on Monday, brokers said.
The Nikkei 225 average climbed 308.73 points, or 1.53 percent, to close at 20,532.55. Its June futures ended 330 points higher at 20,600.
"It is uncertain whether the yen has completely stabilised, but dealers who sold off yesterday rushed to cover shorts," said Kaoru Ichikawa, a senior trader at Kokusai Securities Co Ltd.
